formula.pairing: scenario key s = '<s_m>_<s_o>' on both sides (the formulation's own index; the TSO's s_o is the TN operation scenario, the DSO's s_o the DN's -- no constraint ties them; the TN interface P/Q is scenario-common, so dP/dQ do not depend on the pairing)
formula.dP: P_TSO[s,t] - P_DSO[s,t] (MW; P_TSO = pc_adn*baseMVA, P_DSO = pg_adn*baseMVA; DN-import positive)
formula.dV: V_TSO[s,t] - V_DSO[s,t] (p.u.; TN ADN bus vs DN reference bus; equal base kV, checked)
formula.d: P_DSO[s,t] - Pbar_DSO[t] (DSO deviation from its own commitment; production _get_local_interface_dispersion)
formula.dP_total: dP + (pnet_TSO-copy - pnet_DSO-copy) (shared ESS at the same bus, both scenario-free)
formula.rms: sqrt(sum_b sum_s omega_s sum_t x^2 / (N_b*24)), representative days equal
formula.rms_blockweighted: sqrt(sum_b w_b sum_s omega_s sum_t x^2 / (sum_b w_b*24)), w_b = admm_block_weight
formula.u: -dP = P_DSO - P_TSO; E_plus = sum_s omega_s sum_t max(u,0) MWh per representative day; *_weighted = sum_b w_b E_b (w_b = years x days x 1.02^-(y-2025): discounted horizon MWh)
formula.C: sum omega_s pi[s_m,t] max(+-u,0) (EUR at the scenario price, DSO block price array)
formula.spreads: max over (DN, block, hour) of max_s x - min_s x, per side
